verdict.rationale: Glama's own pages and its llms.txt describe a catalog of tens of thousands of MCP servers and remote connectors that developers can search, compare and connect to. Any registry server can be deployed onto Glama with the Gateway placed in front of it, so these integrations are reachable through the platform itself. Missing for 10: evidence naming which specific third-party apps or APIs are covered and how well, and independent hands-on confirmation that catalog entries reliably work as hosted integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform
